{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Everyday loungewear crop top in a soft heather gray (#E0E0E0), relaxed crew-neck cut with drop shoulders, hitting mid-bicep length, made from breathable cotton-jersey knit.
High-rise wide-leg jogger pants in deep charcoal slate (#36454F), tapered leg cut ending just above the ankle, crafted from stretchy ponte knit for mobility and shape retention.
Minimalist low-profile trainers in cream leather with white rubber soles (#F5F5DC).
This outfit works perfectly for a morning yoga session followed by coffee because it prioritizes unrestricted movement while maintaining a polished, neat casual aesthetic. The neutral color palette transitions seamlessly from the active studio to a relaxed café setting without needing a change of clothes. Every element is chosen for comfort and functionality, respecting her preference for reading-focused ease during autumn daylight hours."}
